name: dsh-topbar
description: Push DSH session status to the GNOME top bar (Ubuntu/GNOME 3.36). Gray=running, green=done (unacknowledged), yellow=waiting (approval/question/plan review). Configurable from DSH Settings → Plugins; auto-installs its GNOME extension half.

description.zh: 把各会话的运行状态推到 GNOME 顶栏：灰=运行中，绿=已完成未确认，黄=等待回复/审批。可在 设置 → 插件 中配置字号、宽度、上限、显示状态与点击行为。
description.en: Push per-session status to the GNOME top bar: gray=running, green=done, yellow=waiting. Configurable under Settings → Plugins; auto-installs its GNOME extension.
